result:
Feasible today at pilot scale, with the cost picture driven more by subsidy policy than by technology.

## What holds up

The approach works at pilot scale today[^a1c3], and unit cost declined year over year across every region measured[^a2c1].

## Where it is softer

The regional spread looks like a subsidy artefact rather than a technology gap: netted out, it narrows to roughly 20%[^a2c2]. One claim rests only on a secondary round-up that was never fetched[^a3c1].
